## The idea (one paragraph)
What should exist that doesn't, or what should change?

## The player feeling
What does the player feel in the 30 seconds this touches?

## The meeting-engine test
Does this help people meet each other? How, concretely?

## Smallest first step
What's the smallest shippable version of this?

## Open questions for the founder
What can't you decide without him?
